summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the redesigned German-only company website for Garten-und Landschaftspflege B.Streich. Tested both backend API (POST /api/contact with validation, honeypot, rate limiting, admin endpoint) and frontend (all 7 routes + 404, Figtree font, contact form, navigation, legal pages, SEO, static files). All critical functionality working correctly.

BACKEND: POST /api/contact with consent=false returns 400 with German error message
BACKEND: POST /api/contact without phone AND email returns 400 with German error message
BACKEND: POST /api/contact with invalid email returns 422 validation error
BACKEND: POST /api/contact with name < 2 chars returns 422 validation error
BACKEND: POST /api/contact with message < 10 chars returns 422 validation error
BACKEND: POST /api/contact with honeypot filled returns 201 but does NOT store record in database (verified via GET)
BACKEND: GET /api/contact without X-Admin-Token returns 401
BACKEND: GET /api/contact with correct X-Admin-Token returns 200 with list sorted newest first
BACKEND: GET /api/contact limit query parameter works correctly
